judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a definition of done (`.lore/dod.md`), updating `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and adding an acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/usage.acceptance.test.ts`), without actually implementing the production change in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` still overwrites `lastUsage` instead of accumulating usage across rounds, the newly added acceptance tests will fail immediately. Furthermore, the candidate did not update the `OrchestratorHooks` type signature (`totalUsage?: UsageMetadata`), missed the `CHANGELOG.md` entry, and created a separate test file instead of adding to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` where `scriptedProvider` already existed.
